# Rules

gomdlint has 55 rules, and 37 of them can fix what they find. Each rule's page
says what the rule checks and why, lists its options, says what its fix does,
and shows how to configure the rule and silence it.

## Headings

| Name | ID | Fix | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`first-line-heading`](first-line-heading.md) | MD041 | no | Comments aside, the file starts with a top-level heading or front matter title. |
| [`heading-blank-lines`](heading-blank-lines.md) | MD022 | yes | Headings have a blank or comment line above and below. |
| [`heading-increment`](heading-increment.md) | MD001 | no | Each heading is at most one level deeper than the heading or title before it. |
| [`heading-start-left`](heading-start-left.md) | MD023 | yes | Headings start at the beginning of their line, list item or blockquote. |
| [`heading-style`](heading-style.md) | MD003 | yes | Headings all use the first heading's style: \# Title, \# Title \#, or underlined. |
| [`no-duplicate-heading`](no-duplicate-heading.md) | MD024 | no | No two headings have exactly the same text. |
| [`no-emphasis-as-heading`](no-emphasis-as-heading.md) | MD036 | yes | Outside lists and blockquotes, a bold or italic line is not a stand-in heading. |
| [`no-missing-space-atx`](no-missing-space-atx.md) | MD018 | yes | A space follows the \# marks that open a heading at the start of a line. |
| [`no-missing-space-closed-atx`](no-missing-space-closed-atx.md) | MD020 | yes | A closed heading at the start of a line has a space inside each run of \#. |
| [`no-multiple-space-atx`](no-multiple-space-atx.md) | MD019 | yes | Only one space follows the \# marks that open a heading. |
| [`no-multiple-space-closed-atx`](no-multiple-space-closed-atx.md) | MD021 | yes | A closed heading has only one space inside each run of \#. |
| [`no-trailing-punctuation`](no-trailing-punctuation.md) | MD026 | yes | Headings do not end with a period, comma, semicolon, colon or exclamation mark. |
| [`required-headings`](required-headings.md) | MD043 | no | Headings follow the configured outline in order. No outline is set by default. |
| [`single-h1`](single-h1.md) | MD025 | no | A document that starts with a title has no other top-level heading. |

## Lists

| Name | ID | Fix | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`blanks-around-lists`](blanks-around-lists.md) | MD032 | yes | Lists outside other lists have a blank or comment line above and below. |
| [`list-indent`](list-indent.md) | MD005 | yes | Items in a list start at the same column. Ordered numbers may right-align. |
| [`list-marker-space`](list-marker-space.md) | MD030 | yes | One space, or one tab, separates each list marker from the item's text. |
| [`ol-prefix`](ol-prefix.md) | MD029 | yes | Ordered list items are numbered 1, 1, 1, or 1, 2, 3, or 0, 1, 2, and so on. |
| [`ul-indent`](ul-indent.md) | MD007 | yes | Outside ordered lists, bullets sit at the margin and indent 2 spaces per level. |
| [`unordered-list-style`](unordered-list-style.md) | MD004 | yes | Every bullet uses the same marker as the first bullet in the file. |

## Whitespace and layout

| Name | ID | Fix | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`hr-style`](hr-style.md) | MD035 | yes | Every horizontal rule is written the same way as the first one, such as ---. |
| [`line-length`](line-length.md) | MD013 | yes | Lines fit in 80 characters, with exemptions such as lone links and definitions. |
| [`no-hard-tabs`](no-hard-tabs.md) | MD010 | yes | Lines contain no tab characters, including inside code. |
| [`no-multiple-blank-lines`](no-multiple-blank-lines.md) | MD012 | yes | Outside code, no two blank lines follow each other, except after front matter. |
| [`no-trailing-spaces`](no-trailing-spaces.md) | MD009 | yes | Outside code blocks, lines end in no spaces or tabs, or in exactly 2 of them. |
| [`single-trailing-newline`](single-trailing-newline.md) | MD047 | yes | The file ends with a newline, or a last line of only whitespace, \> or comments. |

| [`descriptive-link-text`](descriptive-link-text.md) | MD059 | no | Link text describes its target instead of saying "click here" or "more". |

| [`link-fragments`](link-fragments.md) | MD051 | no | Links to a \#fragment point at a heading or anchor in the same file, or at \#top. |

| [`reference-links-images`](reference-links-images.md) | MD052 | no | Labels in \[text\]\[label\] and \[label\]\[\] references are defined, except x. |
